# akeyless_certificate (Ephemeral Resource)

Fetches a certificate value without storing it in Terraform state.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Certificate name

### Optional

- `ignore_cache` (String) Retrieve without checking Gateway cache [true/false]
- `version` (Number) Certificate version

### Read-Only

- `certificate_pem` (String, Sensitive) The certificate value in pem format
- `private_key_pem` (String, Sensitive) The private key value in pem format
